

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(forecast)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(countrycode)

Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C")

teal_dark   <- "#015c6d"
teal_mid    <- "#017a8f"
teal_base   <- "#019ab5"
teal_light  <- "#4dc2d6"
teal_pale   <- "#a8e2ec"
teal_ghost  <- "#d9f2f6"

red_dark    <- "#c02200"
red_mid     <- "#fd300b"
red_base    <- "#fd5a38"
red_light   <- "#fe8a70"
red_pale    <- "#feb9a8"
red_ghost   <- "#fee5df"

country_colors <- c(
  "Germany" = teal_dark,
  "Spain"   = teal_base,
  "Czechia" = teal_light,
  "Brazil"  = red_base,
  "India"   = red_light
)

continent_colors <- c(
  "Africa"   = red_dark,
  "Asia"     = red_base,
  "Oceania"  = teal_light,
  "Americas" = teal_base,
  "Europe"   = teal_dark
)

income_colors <- c(
  "High income"         = teal_dark,
  "Upper middle income" = teal_base,
  "Lower middle income" = red_light,
  "Low income"          = red_dark
)

cluster_colors_named <- c(
  "1" = teal_base,
  "2" = teal_dark,
  "3" = red_mid
)

theme_teal <- function() {
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = "black"),
      axis.title       = element_text(colour = teal_dark),
      axis.text        = element_text(colour = "#555555"),
      legend.title     = element_text(colour = teal_dark, face = "bold"),
      legend.text      = element_text(colour = "#555555"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = teal_ghost),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r}
plot_forecast_teal <- function(df, fc, country_name, y_label) {
  
  last_date <- max(df$date)
  future_dates <- seq(
    from = last_date + 1,
    by = "day",
    length.out = length(fc$mean)
  )
  
  observed_df <- df %>%
    select(
      date,
      value = people_fully_vaccinated_per_hundred
    )
  
  forecast_df <- data.frame(
    date = future_dates,
    mean = as.numeric(fc$mean),
    lo80 = as.numeric(fc$lower[, 1]),
    hi80 = as.numeric(fc$upper[, 1]),
    lo95 = as.numeric(fc$lower[, 2]),
    hi95 = as.numeric(fc$upper[, 2])
  )
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = forecast_df,
      aes(x = date, ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95),
      fill = teal_ghost,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = forecast_df,
      aes(x = date, ymin = lo80, ymax = hi80),
      fill = teal_pale,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = observed_df,
      aes(x = date, y = value),
      colour = "#555555",
      linewidth = 0.75
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = forecast_df,
      aes(x = date, y = mean),
      colour = red_mid,
      linewidth = 1.15
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = last_date,
      linetype = "dashed",
      colour = teal_dark,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y") +
    labs(
      title = paste("ARIMA Forecast:", country_name, "Full Vaccination Coverage"),
      subtitle = "30-day forecast with 80% and 95% confidence intervals",
      x = "Date",
      y = y_label
    ) +
    theme_teal()
}
```

```{r}
spain <- vaccinations_country %>%

  ) %>%

  spain$people_fully_vaccinated_per_hundred,
  frequency = 7
)

fit_spain <- auto.arima(
  ts_spain,
  d = 1,
  D = 1,
  stepwise = FALSE,
  approximation = FALSE
)

summary(fit_spain)

checkresiduals(fit_spain)
```

```{r}
accuracy_results <- data.frame()

countries_arima <- c("Spain", "Czechia", "India")

for (ctry in countries_arima) {
  
  df <- vaccinations_country %>%
    filter(
      location == ctry,
      !is.na(people_fully_vaccinated_per_hundred)
    ) %>%
    arrange(date)
  
  n <- nrow(df)
  
  if (n < 30) {
    message(paste("Skipping", ctry, "- not enough data"))
    next
  }
  
  train <- df$people_fully_vaccinated_per_hundred[1:round(n * 0.8)]
  test  <- df$people_fully_vaccinated_per_hundred[(round(n * 0.8) + 1):n]
  
  ts_train <- ts(train, frequency = 7)
  
  fit_arima_train <- auto.arima(
    ts_train,
    d = 1,
    D = 1,
    stepwise = FALSE,
    approximation = FALSE
  )
  
  fit_ets_train <- ets(ts_train)
  
  h <- length(test)
  
  acc_arima <- accuracy(
    forecast(fit_arima_train, h = h),
    test
  )
  
  acc_ets <- accuracy(
    forecast(fit_ets_train, h = h),
    test
  )
  
  accuracy_results <- rbind(
    accuracy_results,
    data.frame(
      Country = ctry,
      Model = "ARIMA",
      RMSE = acc_arima["Test set", "RMSE"],
      MAE  = acc_arima["Test set", "MAE"],
      MAPE = acc_arima["Test set", "MAPE"]
    ),
    data.frame(
      Country = ctry,
      Model = "ETS",
      RMSE = acc_ets["Test set", "RMSE"],
      MAE  = acc_ets["Test set", "MAE"],
      MAPE = acc_ets["Test set", "MAPE"]
    )
  )
}

accuracy_results


```


```{r}
accuracy_results %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = Country,
    y = RMSE,
    fill = Model
  )) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.65,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "ARIMA" = teal_base,
      "ETS" = red_base
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "ARIMA vs ETS Forecast Accuracy",
    subtitle = "Lower RMSE indicates better predictive performance on the test set",
    x = "Country",
    y = "RMSE",
    fill = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_teal()
```


```{r}
countries_arima <- c("Spain", "Czechia", "India")

for (ctry in countries_arima) {
  
  df <- vaccinations_country %>%
    filter(
      location == ctry,
      !is.na(people_fully_vaccinated_per_hundred)
    ) %>%
    arrange(date)
  
  if (nrow(df) < 30) {
    message(paste("Skipping", ctry, "- not enough data"))
    next
  }
  
  ts_ctry <- ts(
    df$people_fully_vaccinated_per_hundred,
    frequency = 7
  )
  
  fit_ctry <- auto.arima(
    ts_ctry,
    d = 1,
    D = 1,
    stepwise = FALSE,
    approximation = FALSE
  )
  
  fc_ctry <- forecast(fit_ctry, h = 30)
  
  print(
    plot_forecast_teal(
      df = df,
      fc = fc_ctry,
      country_name = ctry,
      y_label = "Fully vaccinated per 100"
    )
  )
}
```


## Multi-Country ARIMA Forecast (Inequality Comparison)

```{r multicountry_arima, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
countries_arima <- c("Germany", "India", "Spain")

for (ctry in countries_arima) {

  df <- vaccinations_country %>%
    filter(
      location == ctry,
      !is.na(people_fully_vaccinated_per_hundred)
    ) %>%
    arrange(date)

  if (nrow(df) < 30) {
    message(paste("Skipping", ctry, "- not enough data"))
    next
  }

  ts_ctry <- ts(
    df$people_fully_vaccinated_per_hundred,
    frequency = 7
  )

  fit_ctry <- auto.arima(
    ts_ctry,
    d = 1,
    D = 1,
    stepwise = FALSE,
    approximation = FALSE
  )

  fc_ctry <- forecast(fit_ctry, h = 30)

  print(
    plot_forecast_teal(
      df = df,
      fc = fc_ctry,
      country_name = ctry,
      y_label = "Fully vaccinated per 100"
    )
  )
}
```
